original_test_intent: Verify all expected LOWER_FAN1 through LOWER_FAN5 R-position resources in BMC Web, including lower-bank assembly/pair identity, RPM, units, health, thresholds, freshness and SPEC range.

manual_activity: A platform reviewer confirms lower-bank/R-channel identity, all five pair mappings and the complete rendered comparison to the approved cooling SPEC.

Do not infer bank or R semantics

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Index evidence by lower-bank assembly and R channel, explicitly linking each F partner before interpreting speed and status.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical bank, paired-channel and completeness gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The preceding F result cannot prove the second rotor/tach path, whose failure may reduce cooling redundancy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Paired speeds need not be identical; only project-defined control tolerances may be applied.

project_override_considerations: Define lower-bank membership, R meaning, five assemblies, F partners and any allowed paired-speed relationship. Duplicate HSC power coverage stays separate.

Per-member assembly/F-pair, RPM, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and SPEC criterion consistently target lower R-position fans. Generic clear and HSC power output are method/reference defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bank topology, suffix semantics, SPEC and UI are identifiable inputs; execution becomes BLOCKED if the lower-R mapping remains ambiguous after the package request.

review_improvement: Preserves the independent lower-R tach path and prevents prior F-channel or unrelated power readings from hiding a paired-fan failure.
independent_technical_reasoning: The R tachometer is a separately observable channel even when it shares a lower fan cartridge and control policy with F. Loss, duplication or cross-bank mapping of that channel can reduce fault visibility without changing the partner RPM, so each of five R identities must be proven independently.
